description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {1}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Malakir Blood-Priest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix ability, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Malakir Blood-Priest by paying {B}.
Malakir Blood-Priest enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Malakir Blood-Priest's ability, causing each opponent to lose at least 1 life and you to gain at least 1 life.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
